items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Dave Liebman told me he says, “Man you went from uptight to up loose” you know.

ctx.x: That’s great. Well moving from any big band, as you mentioned, you get a limited amount of time to solo. You know sometimes the leader might say open it up, go around again, but still not too long. So going to Elvin Jones, I’m guessing that was a big change in adjustment for you.

Yeah we used to have a chart on Buddy’s band called “Uptight.” Do you remember that? [sings] Uptight. So Dave Liebman told me he says, “Man you went from uptight to up loose” you know. Because you know all of a sudden now I’m coming from, you know, you have a solo in a big band and you stand up, you’ve got to go, it’s like machine gun time you know, most of the time, unless it’s a ballad or a medium thing, but you have to kind of jump in there. And you don’t leave space, none of that stuff really comes — now I go…
Was the difference in bass players — make a difference in your playing when you were with Elvin?
